$comment: Owner exceptions to the captured fidelity contracts (fidelity/exceptions.mjs). Each entry is one sanctioned difference between the port and the winner: target names contract.<target>.json, key and prop the captured value, winner the value it overrides and port the value the port holds instead. run.mjs applies them to a copy of the contract at check time, so a recapture never erases one; an entry whose winner moved, that matches nothing, repeats another or lacks its why/decided fails the gate. Never edit a captured contract to make the port pass: add an entry here.
